board_name: Fun activities to do in Nature for kids
title: Put the phones down. Call a Secret Meeting.
description: Sometimes the best family activity is simply sitting down together. Draw a TALK, IMAGINE or DO card, take turns, laugh, listen and finish with one tiny Earth mission. The 16-card Gaia’s Secret Agents Founding Pack is A$5, printable at home and instantly downloadable.
alt_text: Gaia’s Secret Agents Secret Meeting Cards Founding Pack for screen-free family connection, conversation, imagination and small Earth-positive actions.
